name: Green Valley Creamery Lactose-Free Organic Sour Cream
whyItWorks: Certified organic cream treated with lactase enzyme and cultured with live probiotic microbes. 100% lactose-free and certified Low-FODMAP by Monash University. The gold-standard sour cream for sensitive guts.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Dollop over baked potato flesh, soft corn tacos, or stir into chicken soups for creamy richness.
